comment: Solarized Dark. Source: https://github.com/altercation/solarized (README.md, the scss snippet with the rebase mixin). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2011 Ethan Schoonover; the text is in LICENSE-solarized. Roles: text = base0, weak = base01, rule = base02, accent = violet, run = blue, ok = green, error = red, add = green, remove = red, tint = base02, code = base02, background = base03. Solarized names one background tone beyond the base, so rule, tint and code are the same value. Adjusted for contrast, nothing else changed: weak #586e75 (base01) -> #5e767d: lightness 40% -> 43% for 3:1 on #002b36 (was 2.79:1).
